description: Get product catalog with inventory levels, pricing, cost, margins, status, and SEO metadata. Returns: title, vendor, productType, price, cost, margin, marginPercent, totalInventory, seoTitle (Shopify global.title_tag), seoDescription (Shopify global.description_tag), productUrl (full storefront URL — use this directly instead of guessing). Use for questions about products, pricing, profitability, cost price, stock levels, or SEO/meta tags.

store.description: Filter to a specific store domain. Omit to query all connected stores.

name: get_product_catalog
